description: PHP class implementing Twig's SandboxExtension for security sandboxing, including methods for enabling/disabling sandbox, security checks, and handling source policies.

classes.name: SandboxExtension
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractExtension, providing sandbox security features for Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing security policies and sandbox state.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns an array with a new SandboxTokenParser instance.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array with a new SandboxNodeVisitor instance.

methods.name: isSandboxed
methods.description: Checks if sandboxing is active globally, locally, or for a specific source.

methods.name: isSandboxedGlobally
methods.description: Returns whether sandboxing is enabled globally.

methods.name: checkSecurity
methods.description: Checks security for tags, filters, and functions if sandboxed.

methods.name: checkMethodAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a method call is allowed on an object.

methods.name: checkPropertyAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a property access is allowed on an object.

methods.name: ensureToStringAllowed
methods.description: Ensures an object can be safely converted to string under sandbox rules.

methods.name: ensureToStringAllowedForArray
methods.description: Recursively checks array elements for string conversion permissions.
